title: 空客CEO：需求强劲，订单积压超9200架飞机
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Is the demand story looking okay at the moment?
segments.zh: 目前需求情况看起来还好吗？

segments.en: I've got a goal for that's getting worse. I've got an all price that's at 90 bucks a barrel.
segments.zh: 我的目标在承压，油价到了90美元一桶。

segments.en: Any sign at this show that consumers is starting to get a little bit more cautious again?
segments.zh: 这次展会有没有迹象显示消费者又开始变得谨慎？

segments.en: Well, it's the first day of the show and it started very strongly.
segments.zh: 今天是展会第一天，开局非常强劲。

segments.en: We still see a very strong demand for our products.
segments.zh: 我们仍然看到产品需求非常旺盛。

segments.en: We have a backlog of more than 9,200 aircraft and we continue to get fresh orders for our short-distance aircraft.
segments.zh: 我们有超过9200架飞机的积压订单，短途飞机还在不断获得新订单。

segments.en: We have a long range aircraft. The middle is crisis is actually fooling some demand because price of oil is very high
segments.zh: 我们有远程飞机。中间危机实际上因为油价高企而催生了一些需求，

segments.en: and fully efficient aircraft are in more demand. Do you like the economy right now and do you get a sense that what we say at the moment is sustainable?
segments.zh: 高效飞机更受欢迎。您喜欢当前的经济状况吗？您觉得目前的情况可持续吗？

segments.en: It's a, or are you starting to get a little bit nervous?
segments.zh: 还是您开始有点紧张了？

segments.en: Well, it's a very complex economy. It's a very complex world, very fast-changing, very unpredictable, but we have more visibility
segments.zh: 嗯，经济非常复杂。世界非常复杂，变化极快，难以预测，但我们的可见度更高。

segments.en: than others with the backlog we have with a very strong demand for transport, for commercial aviation and with defense.
segments.zh: 相比其他公司，我们的订单积压量很大，运输、商业航空和防务领域需求强劲。

segments.en: So I think given the environment, we can't complain.
segments.zh: 所以，在当前环境下，我们没什么可抱怨的。

segments.en: Okay, quite a bit of visibility. So you've got a really big backlog, particularly of the narrow-body aircraft.
segments.zh: 好的，可见度很高。你们的订单积压很大，尤其是窄体飞机。

segments.en: You'd like to produce more of them, but you're struggling. You've got well-documented engine issues.
segments.zh: 你们想增产，但遇到了困难，发动机问题众所周知。

segments.en: You and I have joked in the past about building gliders.
segments.zh: 我们以前开玩笑说造滑翔机。

segments.en: You'd like to produce a rate 75, but you probably can't.
segments.zh: 你们想达到月产75架，但可能做不到。

segments.en: So what rate can you produce at? What are you doing right now?
segments.zh: 那你们实际能生产多少？现在在做什么？
